focus: REPL — a block goes in as a whole, with its END
query: Open a REPL with our orders resource. In one FOR loop, look up the orders 42, 7 and 99 with `Submit Order`, and keep going when a lookup fails, so that at the end you can tell me which worked and which didn't. Close the REPL at the end.
expected_behavior: Runs the REPL as a session, or at its prompt if its shell tool can write to a running command
Sends the whole `FOR` block with its `END` as one input, not line by line
Catches the failure inside the loop (`TRY` / `EXCEPT`, `Run Keyword And Ignore Error`) so the loop goes on
Reports that 42 and 7 worked and 99 didn't, and closes the REPL
